en: Hello, forest! Welcome to the festival!

where: beat 16 (7.68 s), just after her wings land on the stage; the forest cheers back at beat 24

how: warm, teasing, rising on the question

en: And high up... the little flyers!

en: The beetles and the dragonflies too!
how: delighted, a surprise guest act

en: Thanks for the party! Good night, forest!
